lines.text: Many learners say: I went there by the plane.
Better: I went there by plane.
With by, do not add the.

data.wrong: I went there by the plane.
data.why: With by, do not add the.

native.hook: by the plane？ the はいらない
native.tip: 乗り物の手段を言う by のあとには the も a も付けません。
native.caption: “I went there by the plane.”と言っていませんか？😅 「〜で行く」と手段を言うときは by plane、by train のように冠詞なしで言います。 “I went there by plane.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“plane”。by のあとは冠詞なし。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: After by, name the vehicle with no a or the.
en.caption: Do you say “I went there by the plane.”? 😅 To say how you travel, use by plane or by train with no article. The natural way is “I went there by plane.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
